item.title: Why Pakistan has emerged as a mediator between US and Iran
item.summary: Pakistan has emerged as an unexpected mediator, offering to help bring Washington and Tehran to the negotiating table as fears of a wider regional conflict escalate following U.S. and Israeli strikes on Iran that began in late February

item.title: Iran war deflects attention from Ukraine as Russia starts spring offensive
item.summary: The Iran war has deflected global attention from Russia’s all-out invasion of its neighbor Ukraine as Europe’s biggest conflict since World War II enters its fifth year and an emboldened Kremlin undertakes a spring offensive

item.title: A knife-wielding man kills a woman at a Tokyo Pokemon shop before taking his own life
item.summary: A knife attack at a Pokémon store in downtown Tokyo has left a woman and the attacker dead, police say

item.title: Gulf of Mexico oil spill spread hundreds of miles, killed wildlife and polluted Mexican reserves
item.summary: Mexican authorities say a March oil spill in the Gulf of Mexico spread more than 600 kilometers and reached protected areas

item.title: Two British men detained in a suspected antisemitic hate crime are released on bail
item.summary: British police say two men arrested in connection with an arson attack that destroyed four ambulances owned by a Jewish charity have been released on bail as authorities continue to investigate the suspected antisemitic hate crime

item.title: Nepal's new prime minister chooses auspicious time to take oath of office
item.summary: Nepal’s youngest prime minister will take the oath of office in a ceremony shaped as much by astrology as politics

item.title: Slovenia says it has confirmed foreign influence on last weekend's election
item.summary: Slovenia’s government says its intelligence service has confirmed foreign influence around the country’s parliamentary election

item.title: Snow and stormy winds close schools and roads, and cut power in some Balkan countries
item.summary: Stormy winds, rain and snow have closed schools and left thousands of people without electricity in some Balkan countries while snarling traffic throughout the region and pulling out trees and ripping off rooftops

item.title: Landslides triggered by heavy rainfall kill at least 20 people in Tanzania
item.summary: Heavy rains and strong winds have triggered deadly landslides and floods across East Africa, with southern Tanzania reporting at least 20 deaths

item.title: Costa Rica to accept 25 'third country' deportees from US every week
item.summary: Costa Rica said that it would accept 25 “third party” migrants deported from the United States per week
